retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, surrealist collage where musical instruments are arranged to form a human face against a high-contrast magenta background.
triggerTerms: vibrant magenta and lime green surrealism
excludeWhen: muted or pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, lime-green organic shape resembling a human head profile is set against a solid magenta field. Inside this shape, a piano keyboard forms the forehead, a guitar forms the nose, drums and cymbals form the eyes, and a stylized mouth appears at the bottom, creating a pareidolic musical portrait.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast complementary pairing of magenta and lime green
Pareidolic arrangement of instruments into facial features
Organic central silhouette against a flat, geometric background
Layered, textured illustrative style within the central figure
coreInvariants: Central lime green organic container shape
Piano keys positioned at the top of the central shape
Yellow electric guitar positioned vertically as a nose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central organic shape occupying 70% of the frame, slightly tilted.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow guitar body in the center of the green shape.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top piano keys down through the guitar nose to the mouth at the base, then out to the corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive solid magenta field surrounding the central figure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow guitar and gold typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary elements with high value contrast between the yellow and magenta.

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text to maintain 80s minimalist graphic style.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and rounded character shapes.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid magenta canvas. In the center, place a large, organic lime-green shape. Inside the green shape, arrange a piano keyboard at the top, two circular drum/cymbal illustrations as eyes, a yellow electric guitar as a nose, and a stylized mouth at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold geometric sans-serif text in yellow to the top left and top right corners, ensuring the text is small and clean.

verificationChecks: Does the central figure form a face using instruments?
Is the typography yellow and placed in the top corners?
Is the guitar yellow and positioned vertically?

adjustableVariables: Instrument types used for facial features
Curvature of the central green shape
postGenerationChecks: The face is clearly recognizable as being made of instruments.
The magenta background is uniform and vibrant.
The lime green shape has a distinct organic silhouette.
The typography is legible and correctly positioned in the corners.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Solid Vibrant Background] + [Organic Contrasting Container] + [Thematic Objects Arranged as Face] + [Corner-Aligned Geometric Typography].
